import numpy as np
# output from demonstrated input is T=rot180(input) tiled vertically with every other tile vertically flipped, and each row's right tile horizontally reflected
def transform(grid):
    a=np.array(grid, dtype=int)
    t=np.rot90(a,2)
    blocks=[]
    for i in range(3):
        v=t if i%2==0 else np.flipud(t)
        blocks.append(np.concatenate([v,np.fliplr(v)],axis=1))
    return np.concatenate(blocks,axis=0).tolist()
out=transform(inp.tolist())
print(np.array_equal(np.array(out), np.tile(np.array([[0]]),(1,1))))
print(np.array(out)[:6,:])
print(transform([[2],[2]]))
